purpose: Pass/fail rules for the free offline semantic audio layer: coarse sound class timeline (speech, singing, music, other sound, silence) with abstention, and word-timed speech transcription. Timing, count and sync stay with the deterministic av-event-meter.

models.sound_classes: Google YAMNet classification TFLite v1, SHA-256 10c95ea3eb9a7bb4cb8bddf6feb023250381008177ac162ce169694d05c317de (same file used on 2026-10-15)
models.speech: faster-whisper 1.2.1 with preserved base.en model from release asset 638696861 (SHA-256 78634f845a29c523d117a29a1a14b293220787f5ede2c6c0f33a9b06c2f805cb), CPU int8

ground_truth_by_construction: Digital silence: control c03 audio (all-zero PCM).
Pure tones: control c04 audio (three 1 kHz 100 ms tones).
Noise: 8 s pink noise at -30 dBFS.
Known speech: espeak-ng renders fixed English sentences; text is known exactly.
Speech over real music: the same known speech mixed at a fixed level over each of the five preserved real openings (music measured as present by YAMNet on 2026-10-15 for j2rk8ycXe3c).

rules.silence: c03: no speech, singing or music segment; zero transcribed words.
rules.non_speech_hallucination: c04 tones and pink noise: zero transcribed words with probability >= 0.5 and no speech segment.
rules.known_speech_detection: Clean espeak speech: speech class on >= 70% of frames that overlap the rendered speech span.
rules.known_speech_transcription: Clean espeak speech: word error rate <= 0.15 against the known text (case and punctuation ignored).
rules.speech_over_music: Each of the five real openings with known speech mixed in: word error rate <= 0.30, and speech class present on >= 50% of speech-span frames.
rules.music_presence: Each real opening without added speech: music class on >= 80% of frames (descriptive check against the 2026-10-15 YAMNet observation; reported, not used to claim human-verified music).
rules.abstention: A frame whose best coarse score is below 0.30 is labelled UNCERTAIN, never forced into a class.

failure_policy: Any failed rule is FAIL; criteria are not edited after results to pass.
